title: Removing the multi-provider guard makes an ambiguous crypto classpath silently pick a provider instead of failing
description: Removing multi-provider guard causes ambiguous crypto provider selection to silently pick a provider based on jar order instead of failing. FIPS deployment that accidentally includes keycloak-crypto-default now boots on non-FIPS BouncyCastle instead of failing at startup as intended.

title: Dead code: two ASN.1 encoders are built and discarded
description: Lines 114–115 create two ASN1Encoder instances, write values into them, and discard results; return statement constructs four fresh encoders and does the real work. Harmless at runtime but invites future misuse.
